manifest.author: kody-w
manifest.description: Makes a Brainstem speak every agent-host dialect from one file: Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI and open Agent Skills — skills, plugins, slash commands/prompts, subagent personas, hooks, MCP servers, instruction files — plus cross-host search of your local Claude Code and Copilot CLI session transcripts.
manifest.name: @kody-w/host_compat_agent

args.description: For load ($ARGUMENTS), run (script args), or hook (matcher / tool name).

arguments.description: For mcp_call: the tool's arguments object.

cwd.description: For transcripts: only sessions whose working directory contains this text.

days.description: For transcripts/index: how many days back to index (default 30).

host.description: Restrict to one host's catalog or transcripts (default all).

kind.description: For list: which catalog to show (default all).

name.description: Skill / command / persona / plugin / MCP server / agent / session id (plugin-qualified 'plugin:name' allowed).

path.description: For read/run: file path relative to the skill or plugin directory. For export: output directory.

query.description: For list: substring filter. For transcripts: the search terms (all must match).

role.description: For transcripts: only messages from this role.

source.description: For install: local directory path or git URL of a plugin (or a bare skill folder).

stdin.description: For run/hook: text (usually JSON) sent on stdin.

timeout.description: Seconds to allow a script/hook/MCP call or an index pass (default 120).

tool.description: For mcp_call: the MCP tool name.
